clue.text: Losing face and turning around: psychological problems for a children's doctor?

indicators.note: turning around makes what is left face the other way, read from its end
a word's face is its front, so losing it drops the opening letter

parts.note: someone with issues has emotional or psychological troubles

explanation.surface: A paediatrician burned out and turning on their heel, troubled in the mind.
explanation.walkthrough: ISSUES loses its I to leave SSUES, which read backwards is SEUSS. The question mark flags that this doctor is not medical at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Dr. Seuss, author of The Cat in the Hat, is a jokey 'doctor' famous for writing children's books.

clue.text: Bad roast reeks terribly for some on 27s

indicators.note: doing something terribly means doing it badly and out of order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A burnt roast smells awful to some people on the move.
explanation.walkthrough: 27 refers to the answer at 27 across, WHEEL; 'Bad' looks like a second anagram signal but it is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Skateboarders ride boards mounted on wheels, so they are among the people who travel on wheels.

clue.text: Shipping company originally transported paintings for parvenu

parts.note: UPS is the United Parcel Service delivery firm

indicators.note: what a word is originally is how it starts, its first letter

parts.note: the first letter of transported
paintings collectively are art

explanation.surface: A courier firm first carried pictures for a newly rich buyer.
explanation.definitionFit: A parvenu is someone who has risen suddenly in wealth or status, an upstart.

clue.text: Upset? Howl loudly for dessert

indicators.note: something said loudly is heard, so its sound counts rather than its spelling

parts.note: sore means upset or aggrieved
a hound bays when it howls

explanation.surface: A child annoyed and wailing to be given pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: This works with the American pronunciation, sor-BAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorbet is a frozen fruit ice served at the end of a meal, a kind of dessert.

clue.text: Australian native to evade law

parts.note: to duck a question is to evade it
a bill is a proposed law

explanation.surface: An Australian-born person trying to dodge the legal system.
explanation.definitionFit: The duckbill, or platypus, is an egg-laying mammal found only in eastern Australia.

clue.text: Most fatal diseases initially let ideas run rampant

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: the first letter of diseases

indicators.note: things running rampant are out of control and scattered

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The worst illnesses first allowed wild thinking to spread.
explanation.definitionFit: Deadliest is the superlative of deadly, meaning causing death most often, a synonym of most fatal.

clue.text: Cold and firm vegetable

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
hard means firm, not soft

explanation.surface: A description of a chilled, crisp vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Chard is a leafy green plant related to beet, eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Like a necklace worn by the man, topless?

indicators.note: something worn by another is wrapped around it, so one piece surrounds the other

he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A man wearing only a necklace with no shirt on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' usually means shirtless; here it means having lost one's top, the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone beheaded has had the head cut off, so is jokingly without a top.

clue.text: Attack the French scream

parts.note: la is the feminine form of the in French
to scream is to shout

explanation.surface: A French battle cry with yelling.
explanation.definitionFit: To lash out is to strike or speak against someone suddenly and violently, to attack them.

clue.text: Courts keeping us in a foreign country

indicators.note: something that keeps another thing holds it inside itself

parts.note: atria are open courtyards in a building
taken as written

explanation.surface: Courts abroad holding Americans in custody.
explanation.walkthrough: 'us' sits inside ATRIA after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Austria is a nation in central Europe, so for an American setter it is a country overseas.

clue.text: Bears in a snapshot, at a loss for words

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: one thing placed in another sits inside its letters

parts.note: pic is informal for a photograph
to bear something is to have it, as a tree bears fruit

explanation.surface: Someone shown a photo of bears and left speechless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bears' looks like the animals, but it is the verb meaning has.
explanation.definitionFit: Aphasia is a medical loss of the ability to produce or understand speech, so an aphasic person cannot find words.

clue.text: Trial on covers can be this!

definitions.text: Trial on covers can be this!

indicators.note: what the words can be is a possible rearrangement of them

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A court case splashed across magazine covers can stir up argument.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: the letters of trial on covers make the answer, and a front-page trial is exactly that.
explanation.definitionFit: Something controversial provokes public dispute, which a heavily publicised court case does.

clue.text: Electronic handle on retro computer is covered with a glossy surface

parts.note: E is the standard abbreviation for electronic, as in e-mail
a handle is slang for a person's name

indicators.note: retro means backwards-looking, so the word is read the other way

parts.note: Dell is a computer maker

explanation.walkthrough: 'on' just places the computer after the handle. The spelling with double L is the British one, which the length requires.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamel is a hard shiny coating, so something enamelled has been given a glossy finish.

clue.text: Decorate nurse after commotion

explanation.surface: An instruction to put up decorations on a nurse once the fuss has died down.
explanation.definitionFit: To adorn something is to make it beautiful by adding ornaments, which is what decorating means.

clue.text: Hot cereal as an appetizer? $&@#%*^!

indicators.note: an appetizer is served first, so this part leads the answer

parts.note: oat is a cereal grain
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

explanation.surface: A bowl of hot porridge served as a starter, met with a string of curses.
explanation.walkthrough: The run of symbols is the cartoon convention for a swear word.
explanation.definitionFit: An oath can mean a profane curse, which comic strips print as a jumble of typographical symbols.

clue.text: Circular trestle?

parts.note: surface reading: a round frame used to hold up a table top
setter's reading: the word trestle is itself a new arrangement of the word letters

explanation.walkthrough: A circular is a printed sheet sent to many readers. Split the answer as NEWS LETTER, read 'new's letters': trestle is the word letters freshly rearranged, and the question mark flags the joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A newsletter is a regular bulletin mailed out to members or customers, the same thing as a circular.

clue.text: Autocrat converted angstrom to newton

indicators.note: something converted has been changed into a different form

parts.note: taken as written
N is the symbol for the newton, the unit of force

explanation.surface: A dictator switching a unit of length into a unit of force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to newton' adds the N to the fodder before shuffling.
explanation.definitionFit: A strongman is a political leader who rules by force, a dictator or autocrat.

clue.text: Killer and jerk like immoral behavior

parts.note: an ass is a fool or jerk
as means like, in comparisons
sin is wrongdoing

explanation.surface: A murderer and a lout who behave wickedly.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a person who murders, usually a prominent figure, so a killer.

clue.text: Storehouse of edited prose beginning to irritate conservative

indicators.note: text that has been edited has been rearranged and reworked

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter alone

parts.note: the opening letter of irritate
a Tory is a British Conservative

explanation.surface: An archive of rewritten writing that starts to annoy a right-winger.
explanation.definitionFit: A repository is a place where things are kept or stored, a synonym for storehouse.

clue.text: Favorite class becomes less important

parts.note: a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet
a tier is a level or class

explanation.surface: A best-loved course loses its significance.
explanation.definitionFit: Petty means trivial, so pettier is the comparative: more trivial, of smaller consequence.

clue.text: Pole, for example, starts to slip, limiting American vaulter

indicators.note: the starts of the following words are their first letters only

parts.note: the first letters of these four words

explanation.surface: A pole vaulter's equipment starts to slide, holding back the US athlete.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital P hides that Pole means a person from Poland, not the vaulting pole.
explanation.definitionFit: Poles are one of the Slavic peoples of central and eastern Europe, so a Pole is an example of a Slav.

clue.text: A closet that's messy? Some people can't tolerate it

indicators.note: a messy arrangement is jumbled out of its tidy order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cluttered cupboard that some people find unbearable.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition sounds like disapproval of mess; it means a digestive intolerance.
explanation.definitionFit: Lactose is the sugar in milk, and people with lactose intolerance cannot digest it.

clue.text: A lot of claptrap, so cute it's a laugh

parts.note: guff is empty talk or nonsense

explanation.surface: So much sentimental nonsense that it becomes laughable.
explanation.definitionFit: A guffaw is a loud hearty burst of laughter.

clue.text: Complex tradition conceals more

indicators.note: what the phrase conceals lies tucked within its letters

parts.note: runs across the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: An intricate custom that hides something further.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra means additional, beyond the usual amount, which is what more means.

clue.text: Someone on the radio with Fred Astaire, say, coming in late to accommodate a person, place, or thing

indicators.note: to accommodate something is to make room for it inside
someone arriving late misses the start, so the first letter goes

parts.note: Fred Astaire was a celebrated Hollywood dancer
the schoolroom definition of a noun

explanation.surface: A radio host introducing Fred Astaire, who turns up late for a guest, a venue or a prop.
explanation.walkthrough: Arriving late, the dancer loses his opening letter; 'a person, place, or thing' is the schoolbook definition of a part of speech.
explanation.definitionFit: An announcer is the person who speaks on air introducing programmes or reading news.

clue.text: Income tax: time to feel sick about promotion

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: to ail is to be unwell
PR, public relations, is promotion

explanation.surface: Tax season is when one feels ill over a job promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: US federal income tax returns are due on April 15.
explanation.definitionFit: In the United States April is the month when annual income tax filings fall due.

clue.text: Psycho is crosscut?

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'crosscut' reads as one film-editing word, but it splits: cross is fodder and cut is the definition.

clue.text: One follows corrupt aims of gangsters

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Roosevelt's unconsummated affair maintaining status

clue.text: I'm having fun with large spinner
